cases.topic: 仅根据保存证据说明虚构Sable shield的取消行为和可见等价代码；保留标题中的版本范围。
cases.title: Sable v2.1 reference
cases.snippet: API reference for Sable tasks and cancellation.
cases.page:
Sable shield protects the task from caller cancellation; the caller still receives CancelledError. The statement:
job = create_task(work())
result = await shield(job)
is equivalent to:
result = await work()
except that caller cancellation does not cancel job.
